page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a heading at top; the dedication text in italic, followed by a signature block of centred roman lines and a right-aligned signature. Page number at top right. Google digitiser watermark at bottom right (excluded).

main_text.head: DEDICATIO.

p.i: sium, Ephorum fidissimum, qui hæc & similia fusius suo tempore explanabit: nec immerito: præsertim cum haud dubie aliquando magni iuris & æquitatis patroni sitis futuri. Deum precor, ut Generosam vestram Magnificentiam, tanquam singulare Decus & Ornamentum Academiæ nostræ, diutissime florentem & incolumem seruet. Heidelbergæ e museo meo, 26. Ian. Anno 1612.

main_text.p: Iohan. Caluinus, Iuris Professor in Academ. Heidelb.

page.notes: The first line of the dedication is a fragment ("sium" for "sium" at the start of a page continuation); the heading and opening words are set in italic. Several words in the italic block are rendered with long-s and ligature forms, transcribed as plain letters. The signature block "Deditiss." and "Iohan. Caluinus" are set in roman type, right-aligned.
